values.note: All sites $34 a night. A Lambeau Field event (games, concerts) raises it to $70 a day for the day before and the day of. For the rest of 2026 registration is by envelope, cash or check only.

values.note: First-come only; no camping while special events are on at the fairgrounds. At most 21 consecutive days, then 14 days away from any Brown County campground.

booking.source: https://www.browncountywi.gov/community/parks-department/general-information/camping/ ('Reservations are not accepted, campsites at the Brown County Fairgrounds are available at a first-come, first-serve basis only.'; 'When special events are scheduled at the Fairgrounds, we will be unable to accept campers.'; 'Camping is allowed for no more than 21 consecutive days. You must vacate any Brown County campground for fourteen (14) days before returning for an additional 21 days.'), read 2026-11-16

note: Brown County Parks campground on the fairgrounds midway in De Pere, near the Fox River, with a boat launch. Camping stops while the fair and other scheduled events are on: the county posts the blocked dates, so check them before arriving. No tents. --Claude
summary: County page read: $34 all sites (rustic $22 in the fees note belonged to other county campgrounds), $70 Lambeau event rate, 46 sites with water+electric (map), showers, dump, WiFi, first-come only, 21-day limit (new), closed Nov 16-Dec 31 2026. Fairgrounds test passed: the midway takes campers on any date without a scheduled event. Phone was null.
flags: FAIRGROUNDS: rents ordinary nights outside events - 'Camping is permitted on the midway during available dates. When special events are scheduled at the Fairgrounds, we will be unable to accept campers.' Imagery shows RVs parked on the midway on a non-fair date. Stays.
